migration_flags.summary: hr.attendance.overtime model (v16/v17) fully replaced by hr.attendance.overtime.line + hr.attendance.overtime.ruleset + hr.attendance.overtime.rule models in v19
out_reason_id field is NOT present in Community v19 hr.attendance model
hr_attendance_reason_ids field is NOT present in Community v19 hr.attendance model
overtime_company_threshold and overtime_employee_threshold on res.company are marked TODO Remove in master — legacy from previous overtime architecture
in_mode and out_mode selection fields gained new values: technical and auto_check_out (out_mode only)
hr.version gains ruleset_id field linking contract version to overtime ruleset — new concept in v19
absence_management company flag + _cron_absence_detection: creates technical attendance for absent employees to generate negative overtime (new in v19)
GIST exclusion constraint preventing overlapping overtime lines is commented out — not DB-enforced in v19
date field on hr.attendance is computed+stored+precomputed, derived from check_in in employee timezone; was not precomputed in earlier versions
Overtime recalculation is fully event-driven on attendance create/write/unlink — no scheduled batch computation

key_findings.worked_hours_formula: sum_intervals(check_in..check_out interval minus lunch intervals for fixed calendar; raw duration for flexible calendar)
key_findings.open_attendance: check_out = NULL means checked-in; max 1 open record per employee enforced by _check_validity constraint; auto-closed by cron when auto_check_out=True on company
key_findings.overtime_models: hr.attendance.overtime.line (per-session lines), hr.attendance.overtime.ruleset (rule groupings), hr.attendance.overtime.rule (quantity or timing triggers)
key_findings.overtime_link: linked_overtime_ids Many2many on attendance via matching time_start=check_in and employee_id
key_findings.kiosk_mechanism: Public URL with company UUID token; barcode/RFID matching employee.barcode; optional PIN via company.attendance_kiosk_use_pin; no hr.attendance.kiosk model
key_findings.multi_company: No direct company_id on hr.attendance; derived via employee_id.company_id
key_findings.absence_detection: _cron_absence_detection creates 1-second technical attendances to generate negative overtime for absent employees (company flag required)
key_findings.no_reason_fields: hr_attendance_reason_ids and out_reason_id NOT present in Community v19
key_findings.version_ruleset_link: hr.version.ruleset_id links contract version to overtime rules; employee.ruleset_id is a related field through active version
